name: dependency-injection-planning
description: Plan dependency injection: injection styles (constructor / setter / method-parameter / property), composition root location, lifetimes + scopes (singleton / scoped / transient / per-request / per-tenant), framework-based vs pure DI (Spring / Guice / Dagger / .NET DI / FastAPI Depends / NestJS / manual), port-adapter boundaries, testability (stubs, fakes, deterministic ports like Clock / RNG / IdGen), lifecycle (start-stop / dispose), circular-dependency detection. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
